text:
tim: ok team quick poll  who wants to start a bench-bounty for playoffs? loser (lowest bench points) buys celebratory donuts. :doughnut:
claire: bench-bounty??? love the energy. rules? do we count weekly bench total or cumulative?
dante: cumulative bench points for the playoffs sounds fair. prevents one-week weirdness.
ivy: i'm in if we can add a bragging rights trophy (handmade, terrible). also can we ban everyone from starting the 0-point kicker intentionally? :eyes:
tim: rules proposal: 1) cumulative bench points across playoff weeks 2) tie -> coinflip recorded on video 3) loser buys donuts + wears the tiny trophy for a week. thoughts?
claire: yes to trophy. we need photos. also tiny trophy should have a ridiculous name like "Bench Baron".
dante: can we make it worse: loser writes a 6-line haiku about why they trusted their waiver pickup. mortal shame.
ivy: haiku accepted. cookies if someone composes it live during standup.
poll-bot: @channel Poll created: "Bench-bounty: participate?" Options: 1) Yes 2) No. Vote with :one: or :two:. Poll ends in 30m.
claire: quick side note: what about IR stash rules? if someone activates an IR and frees a bench spot mid-playoffs does that count?
tim: good Q. house rule: bench points counted only while the player is on your bench at game time. no backdating stash gains. keep it brutal.
dante: thats harsh but consistent. keeps the drama.
ivy: also can we allow swapping the donut reward for a savory option? allergies are real. :salad:
tim: donation option: loser can choose donuts or $20 gift card to coffee shop. fairness for allergies.
poll-bot: Update: 15m in, poll leaning yes 9->3. Poll ends at 2001234767.
dante: i predict this will cause elevated trash talk and one spectacular waiver claim. excited.
claire: if i lose i will absolutely write a haiku and accept the tiny crown. take me now.
ivy: game on. setting a calendar reminder to harass the loser. :calendar_spiral:
tim: ok poll looks decisive. i'll finalize rules and post a signup thread for participants + trophy custody. may the benchiest bench win. :trophy:
